scope: Partial actual iteration27 saved-DT cohort before fixed cutoff; no hand selection, not complete iteration or population accuracy.
initial_bound_auditor_failure: Missing Python path to existing tail_probability_statistics; original saved audit had succeeded. Reused exact existing diagnostic source directory, no install or production change.

audit.scope: Read actual formal records on CPU using the unchanged credit composition owner.
audit.conclusion: CPU persistence/mask/position/finite credit only; no single-deletion accuracy or population recall claim

bounds.scope:
CPU census of saved formal credit against the necessary probability bound.

For a normalized target, interpreting d as log(p_factual/p_deleted) requires
log(p_factual)-d <= 0. This is a necessary check, not a single-deletion oracle,
precision/recall estimate, kernel tolerance or training rule. Retain all saved
DP duplicate views rather than picking whichever numerical view is favorable.
bounds.grouping: Existing PLAN ratio bins; separate completed formal iterations and initial states.
bounds.denominator: Census of saved nonzero DT requests only, unique UID/source positions; no zero-reward or missing first iteration is filled.
bounds.duplicate_views: All saved original DP padding views retained as numerical sensitivity, not independent trajectories.
bounds.numerical_scope: Strict inequalities relative to recorded factual log-prob values; no new numerical tolerance or confidence interval.
bounds.limitation: Within-bound does not prove accurate credit. No native deletion query, recall estimate, correction, clipping or deployment.
